chunks.text: I’m going to be in Nanjing soon, and I’ve been thinking I should line up a doctor visit while I’m there.
Also, I’m planning a Wuhan stop right after that, so I’ve been looking at places to stay around there.
And when I swing through Beijing, I want to spend at least a day just doing the main attractions and wandering around.
For the Nanjing appointment, it’s with Dr. Fang Ming on 2026-05-06 in the afternoon, and it’s under the patient name Hu Bin.

In Wuhan I’m staying at Home Inn Guanggu, checking in 2026-05-03 for 2 nights, and the guest name is Aiden Miller, and I’ve been thinking about what medicine to pack too, since I always forget something and then end up scrambling mid-trip...
